title: WEKAPO Beach Blanket Sandproof Waterproof, Extra Large Beach Mat, Oversized & Compact Sand Free, Quick Drying Beach Essentials for Vacation, Cruise, Picnic & Camping with Stakes

reviews.title: Must Have Beach Accessory
reviews.body: The Sandproof Beach Blanket with WEKAPO Beach Mat has quickly become one of my favorite beach essentials! If you’re tired of bringing half the beach home with you, this is the answer. The sand literally shakes right off, keeping everything clean and comfortable.It’s lightweight, easy to pack, and surprisingly spacious. I love that it stays in place even on windy days, and the material dries quickly if it gets wet. Whether you’re heading to the beach, a picnic, a park, or even an outdoor concert, this blanket is incredibly versatile.I’ve used it multiple times already and couldn’t be happier with the quality. It’s durable, comfortable, and makes every beach trip so much more enjoyable. This is truly a must-have for any and all beach adventures. I highly recommend it to anyone who loves spending time outdoors!10/10 purchase — I wish I had bought it sooner!

reviews.title: GREAT PURCHASE!! Perfect for the beach!
reviews.body: The perfect beach blanket! I recently purchased this for a trip to Amelia Island in Florida. It did exactly what it was supposed to. Waterproof and sandproof! It even held up in the heat really well. The sand got super hot, but the blanket didn't. Thouroghly pleased! Easy to pack back up, and super light and compact.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 26, 2026
reviews.author: Madisyn P.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.body: Love this! I bought this beach blanket with a bit of a “gadget mindset” hoping it would work, but accepting it might be just hype. I was so pleasantly surprised. This stayed perfectly in place and barely got any sand on it. Any sand my kids tracked onto it easy brushed away.We also used it on a very windy day and the blanket just calmly stayed right in place. Our spiral sand umbrella staked 1 ft in the sand had been blown over, yet this blanket didn’t budge.I loved that once the blanket was in place, I could push the sand around underneath it to smooth out our area. No lumps.Takes 1-2 mins to spread out. Same to put away. I was trying too hard folding it to go back in the bag. It doesn’t need that, it just stuff into it fine.

reviews.author: Allison L.

reviews.title: Worth It!
reviews.body: This was great for our beach vacation. It was large enough for our family of 4, and the water and sand came off easily with a quick shake. The stakes held the blanket down with no issues even on very windy days! It is so much easier than putting out a bunch of towels that hold water and sand and blow away. It folds up small and is easy to take to and from the beach. Super easy to clean and store now that our trip is finished. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Game changer at the beach!
reviews.body: This is a game changer at the beach! It’s large size,  cool, and stayed in place with the sand pockets. The bag is attached so you don’t lose it. My only suggestion to make it better would be if the bag was an extra inch in size then you could easily just stuff the blanket onto the bag. The instructions want you to fold it but let’s be honest, no one does that!  Overall I loved the product ❤️

reviews.title: Perfect for beach
reviews.body: Perfect for family beach vacation. Small so it fit in our suitcase for flying. So easy to put out and pack up daily. Appreciate the anchor stakes and pockets to add sand, even on windy days it stayed in place. I was worried about the fabric ripping since it’s a nylon but it held up very well and was comfortable to sit or lay on. Sand brushed off and dried quickly so it was perfect for the beach!

reviews.title: Best beach blanket!
reviews.body: I bought this beach blanket for our beach vacation and it was, by far, the best beach blanket I have ever purchased!! You could easily shake off the sand. My kids found it comfortable to lay on, it was easy to fold up and stuff back in the bag, easy to set up, and it also washes really nicely! I would highly recommend buying this if you go to the beach a lot or have an upcoming beach vacation!!

features: ✔ LARGE AND COMPACT-7'x7'(210cmX210cm) will comfortably fit 1-3 adults, making it one of the most practical beach essentials. Come with 5 metal stakes in a pouch for 4 anchor loops so you will have 1 spare one just in case.

✔ SIMPLE DESIGN & DOUBLE ANCHORED-WEKAPO blanket is designed as simple as possible so it has eliminated 5 sticking out sand pockets and added 4 corner pockets that can be used for storage or sand anchor. If it's windy day, it can be nailed down on beach by metal stakes coming with our blanket.

✔ SAND PROOF AND WATER RESISTANT-This beautifully colored blanket is made of durable ripstop nylon. Just shake the blanket and it easily gets rid of all the sand once. Not only is this wonderful fabric breathable and light-weight, but watch as water beads up and rolls off. The little water that may stay behind will dry VERY FAST.
✔ SUPERIOR QUALITY- Triple stitched for maximum strength and durability - a true beach must-have. All pieces of this blanket are made with lasting use in mind.

✔ MULTIFUNCTIONAL – Use it as a Picnic Blanket, for relaxing during vacation and enjoying a sand-free zone while the kids play with beach toys, hiking/camping or simply for hanging out with friends or family in a garden/backyard – a truly multifunctional beach accessories!
